notes.title: Candy Snake Master release a major update version
notes.notes:
Dear players,

We have a major update on our game according to your feedback, welcome to download the new demo version, the new demo version includes 5 levels at the first scene and first 5 levels in the Time Trial mode.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31795113/f83eb1b511e33df75a6b6975fddc80e39f0690ed.jpg

If you have purchased our game before, you should create a new player in the game now(Click the Change Player link at the main menu screen, then open the Player Manager dialog, you can create a new player at here). You need to start your game from beginning now because the old progress is not supported now.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31795113/add84b7a27dc771ff675223d496b12e5bde181c4.png

Below are some detailed introduction of this update:
1, All of the levels are re-designed.
2, New game mode added, includes Time Trial mode and Challenge mode.
3, New ranking screen added, now you can look at your rank on Adventure mode, Time Trial mode, Challenge mode and your personal recorde.
4, Add light mechanics in the second scene, this make the game more addictive than before.
5, Simplified every level's goal.
6, Simplified game's operation, you can play this game by only moving your mouse now.
7, Add more special effects and sound effects, for example the snake eat candies and power-ups.
8, Other minus bug fixed.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31795113/add84b7a27dc771ff675223d496b12e5bde181c4.png

Thanks for all your support, welcome to download the new game and give me more feedback, so I can upgrade the game constantly.

Thanks again and welcome to write some reviews for the new version.
